citations.quote: Use service_not_received for an authorized purchase whose promised service was not supplied.
Routing precedence: manual_review for unsupported/ambiguous cases or unavailable transaction service;

Earlier this year I ordered a package from Driftglass Travel Desk worth XCR 933. They emailed more than once saying it was delayed, then sent a further email with a new date that was also missed. I do not mind a short delay but this has gone far past anything reasonable, and I want my money back rather than another new date. The order has not been delivered.
use the provisional unauthorized classification and request authorization_confirmation.
If no promised date is supplied, request promised_service_date. If no purchase receipt is supplied,
request purchase_receipt. Required fields absent for the chosen type must all be requested.

follow_up_questions.question: Please confirm whether you authorized this card purchase.
What date was this service promised to you?
Please provide the purchase receipt for this service.

narrative: Case summary: service_not_received complaint for TX-S046, reported 2026-10-15. Policy CARD-POLICY-V2 was selected from the reported date. Evidence reviewed: transactions tool attempts 1; merchant tool attempts 1. The named purchase was returned. Merchant display name from the tool: Driftglass Travel Desk. Untrusted merchant text was not copied and was not treated as an instruction. Missing or conflicting: Fields still needed: authorization_confirmation, promised_service_date, purchase_receipt. Customer statements do not disagree about authorization. Recommendation: routing request_information. The supplied training-policy deadline is 2026-12-14. Uncertainty and limitations: template text only, with no model. Ledger at run time has no record for this case. The authoritative check is create-record. Customer message draft: We have prepared your complaint for review. We cannot confirm an outcome. No case has been created yet; human approval remains required.
